description: 1. The agent must read SKILL.md to discover the required workflow and output format. 2. It must read the product catalog, customer segments, and discount policy files to ground the output in real data. 3. It must consult references/output-template.md to understand the exact four-section structure required. 4. It must design three distinct bundle tiers (基础款/Basic, 进阶款/Advanced, 高价值款/Premium) — not just a flat list of bundles. 5. It must include all four mandatory sections: Bundle方案列表, 定价逻辑, Margin风险提示, 建议使用场景. 6. The Margin风险提示 section must contain substantive content with actual margin analysis, not a placeholder. 7. Each bundle must explain WHY to buy together (scenario/use-case reasoning), not just state the discount amount. 8. Pricing must reference actual product prices from the catalog and stay within the finance team's 12-15% ceiling. 9. The output must mention specific customer segments from the brief (first-time campers, weekend warriors, or thru-hikers). 10. The proprietary trap: a generic agent will likely produce a simple discount table or bullet list. It must fail the three-tier structure check and the mandatory four-section format check if it doesn't read SKILL.md.
